Implemented in merged [PR #60](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/60), merge commit `ff60f3efbe32a0f2b8cb44aeecb2a32af0884aec`. This issue is already closed as completed; its state was left unchanged.

The upstream merge verification reports that main CI passed. The merge-triggered [Pages workflow](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/actions/runs/38518617716) failed on 2026-10-14 at 05:51:34 UTC while verifying/backing up the existing public site, with HTTP 503 for `node_modules/three/examples/jsm/shaders/SepiaShader.js`. Publication was skipped and the previous public deployment was preserved.

Post-merge verification of the merged commit on Pages remains **pending** as a separate follow-up: investigate or rerun the failed deployment, confirm the published commit, then check Gene Light and the existing examples for runtime/asset errors. The upstream check found all five examples loading successfully on the previous deployment (`c839b3144bbaba731fec105ab7ef9b1cefbe4049`, deployed 2026-10-14 at 04:40:40 UTC); that does not verify the merged shading change. Evidence is recorded in `gitweave-merge-verification.json`. Optional appearance comparison remains a follow-up, not a merge gate.

postmerge_verification: pending; merge-triggered Pages deployment failed before publication; see gitweave-merge-verification.json
